meta.title: Villa Layla Hostel — Cairo
meta.description: Book a bed or a private room at Villa Layla Hostel in Cairo, Egypt. Real availability, direct booking.

hero.title: A villa to come home to, in Cairo.
hero.subtitle: Stay in a shared dorm or a private room, meet fellow travellers, and book directly with us — no middlemen, real availability.

home.why1Body: Pick a single bed in a shared dorm or take a whole private room. Prices are shown per bed or per room.
home.why2Body: What you see is the hostel's live inventory — we never offer a bed that is already taken.
home.why3Body: This site and our Telegram assistant work in English, Español, Français and العربية.
home.spacesIntro: A few of the spaces guests share.
home.telegramBody: Book, ask questions or extend your stay with our Telegram assistant — you can even send a voice note.

policies.title: Policies
policies.tbc: The hostel will publish this policy soon. Until then, please ask reception before booking.
policies.how: You send a booking request with real availability. Reception reviews it, tells you how to pay, and confirms. A payment only counts once reception has verified it.

footer.unverified: Content marked “to be confirmed” is awaiting the owner’s approval.

v2.lead: A hostel in a villa with a garden pool. Private rooms with names of their own, dorms by the bed, and reception on WhatsApp around the clock.
v2.privLead: Ten rooms, each with its own name. Most sleep two; the Triple sleeps three.
v2.dormLead: Pay by the bed. Women-only, men-only and one mixed dorm.

life.pool: A pool in the garden, open every day.
life.breakfast: Breakfast is served from 8 to 11 every morning.
life.work: Desks and quiet corners for working days.
life.tours: Day trips leave from the villa every day.

v2.toursLead: Organised every day and booked over WhatsApp.

tours.giza: Giza Pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum

v2.igLead: Reels travellers posted about their stay at the villa.
v2.chatLead: Write to our assistant on Telegram in English, Spanish, French or Arabic. Voice notes work too. Prefer a person? WhatsApp reception any time.
v2.photosLead: Every room and corner of the villa.
v2.roomsLead: Choose a private room or a bed in a dorm. Prices shown are per night.
